description: Metered Parking is a dataset listed in City of New Orleans open data portal (data.nola.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New Orleans. Metered parking stations operated by the City of New Orleans. The stations are categorized by two different types, Single Space Meters (SSM) and Pay Stations (PS) for multiple spaces. Number of spaces managed by the Pay Stations is depicted in the data as well. Coverage: New Orleans. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Infrastructure. Its tags are parking, dpw. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: SP+ Municipal. The portal shows 2023-06-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-nola-gov-portal.
